headline: Vice President, Capital Projects & Engineering
intro: I have worked in the pharmaceutical industry for over three decades. My work is building and running the engineering behind medicine factories: sterile injectable plants, tablet and capsule (oral solid dose) plants, biologics, peptides and API.
I take a facility from the first concept drawing all the way to a qualified, working plant, and make sure it meets the rules of regulators such as the USFDA and the EU (including EU Annex 1).
about: With over three decades in the pharmaceutical industry, I am an engineering and project management professional. I have delivered high-quality, cost-effective projects in complex and niche areas: complex injectables, biosimilars, oncology, oral solid dose (OSD) and API.

As VP – Engineering and Projects at Amneal Pharmaceuticals, I led a team of 450 engineering professionals across several sites in India. I was responsible for greenfield and brownfield projects with an average capex spend of over 12 million US dollars a year, along with energy and maintenance spend across the sites.

My focus has always been the same: meet international regulatory standards, keep improving how plants run, and support the company's growth in global markets, working closely with teams across functions.
I hold a B.E. in Electronics Engineering and an MBA, and I am a certified Project Management Professional (PMP). I also hold certifications in Safety Systems and Process Safety Management.

expertise.text: Designing aseptic plants from concept to qualification: filling lines, isolators, lyophilisers, sterilisers and clean utilities.
Building and running plants that pass USFDA, EU and other international audits, and fixing gaps when they are found.
Greenfield and brownfield projects: business case, budget, design, buying, building, commissioning and handover.
Keeping plants running well and getting more out of them.
Bringing automation and data into the factory.
Leading large engineering teams safely, and speaking the language of finance.

roles.title: Vice President, Capital Projects & Engineering (Injectables | OSD | Peptides | CSR | CSV | SCADA)
points: Leads key engineering capex projects for cGMP compliance (USFDA and EU Annex 1), as well as SCADA, 21 CFR Part 11 and computer system validation (CSV).

Leads potent-molecule complex injectable projects from concept design to commissioning and qualification, including advanced lines from IMA (Italy), containment transfer systems from Fedegari (Italy) and Steris (USA), component autoclaves from Telstar and a utensil washer from ITW (USA).
Leads the upgrade and qualification of advanced manufacturing lines from Germany, Italy and the USA.
Drives digitisation, automation and energy-saving projects to meet operating-cost and ESG targets.
Mentors a team of 250+ engineering professionals across several sites in Himachal Pradesh, and keeps engineering services, safety and quality compliance running at multiple injectable and OSD sites.
Reports to the Chairman & Managing Director, and presents weekly engineering and project progress reports to the CMD and investors.
Works with Indian and international cGMP consultants on USFDA remediation (CAPA), and represents engineering in sessions with USFDA inspectors.
Leads Corporate Social Responsibility work, including cutting carbon emissions through sustainable practices.

roles.title: Vice President – Corporate Projects (OSD, Injectable & Nutraceuticals)
points: Led the preparation of capex proposals for European-market projects in India and overseas (injectables, OSD, warehousing and nutraceuticals), covering market forecasts, cash-flow models, cost breakdowns and timelines, through to Corporate Office approval and CMD sign-off.

roles.title: Vice President – Capital Projects & Engineering (Complex Injectables | OSD | Biologics | API)
points: Led a team of 450 engineering professionals across several sites in India, with greenfield and brownfield projects averaging over $12 million of capex a year.
Led the Octreotide and Lanreotide (peptide) complex injectable facility from design engineering to engineering media fills, within timeline and capex budget.
Led design engineering of a monoclonal antibody (mAbs) drug-substance facility scaling from 200 L to 2,000 L, and built the 2,20,000 sq ft facility in a record 13 months.
Led the selection and master planning of a GLP-1 peptide manufacturing facility, from R&D scale to commercial scale.

Took a TS vial line from concept to installation, commissioning and qualification (ICQ) and media fills; took an in-house designed aseptic bag line and the Spiriva aseptic facility from concept to ICQ.
Delivered a 5,500-pallet automated storage and retrieval (ASRS) warehouse.
Led the engineering team in the due diligence of Puniska Healthcare's injectable facility (100 million units a year).
Rolled out Lean Six Sigma and predictive maintenance, and set up engineering and project academies with faculty from IIT Gandhinagar.

roles.title: Vice President – Capital Projects | Engineering | EHS
points: Kept engineering service uptime above 95% at a plant with three USFDA- and EU-approved oncology injectable blocks and one OSD block, and supported other units in Karnataka.
Led an Industry 4.0 digital transformation towards a 'smart factory': energy optimisation and predictive maintenance using IoT, AI/ML and data analytics.

Worked on brownfield and greenfield projects of about ₹150 crore for US and EU markets, including complex injectables and liposomes, and capacity increases through lyophilisers, compounding vessels and isolators.
Introduced autonomous maintenance (Jishu Hozen), Poka-yoke, Kaizen and Lean Six Sigma tools such as value stream mapping.

roles.title: Lead – Capital Projects in Injectables, OSD
points: Led capital projects worth $40 million across sites, and drove a Centre of Excellence in Engineering.
Worked on capacity expansion across OSD, injectables, derma, contraceptives, high-pressure homogenisers, emulsion systems and microspheres for US and European markets.
Prepared capex proposals with cost and timeline assessment (NPV, IRR), and led techno-commercial negotiations with equipment makers and design consultants.
Improved OEE through TPM and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt projects, brought in ASRS and track & trace for packaging, and generated energy-saving ideas worth more than ₹10 crore.

roles.title: Director Engineering (R4) – Injectable + OSD
points: Cluster head for engineering at the Duvvada (Vizag) cytotoxic OSD, injectable and advanced aseptic formulation facilities, leading 50+ engineers.
Worked with McKinsey on Project SuCCEED to transform the site's quality culture as part of the USFDA remediation plan.
Led world-class maintenance, TPM and OEE work through Lean Six Sigma projects, and PACE energy-saving initiatives.
Faced international audits (SA, TGA, USFDA, Germany and Taiwan), keeping engineering compliance at 100%.

roles.title: Associate Director – Engineering (R3B)
points: Handled engineering detailing and costing for oncology OSD and injectable projects and an advanced aseptic formulation facility meeting USFDA/EU guidelines.
Built and led a team of 40 young engineers, which won the company's Best Work Team award (teams 'KAIZEN' and 'STRIKER').
Installed, commissioned and qualified process equipment such as lyophilisers, sterilisers, vial filling lines and isolators, and applied ASTM E2500 at the project stage.
Worked with USFDA, German and Brazilian auditors and customer audits from GSK, Merck and Mitsubishi.

roles.title: Senior Manager – Engineering (R3A)
points: Headed the engineering services team, keeping the plant safe and compliant.
Worked with the central capex team and equipment makers' engineers from Germany and Italy on remediation of the oncology injectables and OSD facility (FTO-7) to address USFDA observations.
Took part in successful regulatory audits by Germany, Brazil and the USFDA.

roles.title: Head – Engineering, Projects & EHS
points: Led the engineering team through the USFDA inspection in July 2017 with zero observations, making LIFEPharma the first company in the UAE to get USFDA approval.
Ran engineering services for a tablet, capsule and oral liquid plant approved by the USFDA, EU-GMP and Health Canada, and for a cosmetics plant.
Handled approvals with Dubai Civil Defence, Dubai Electricity and Water Authority, Dubai Municipality and others, and held PINK CODE-3 safety accreditation from Trakhees.
Rolled out SAP R/3 maintenance modules (breakdowns, preventive maintenance, calibration, change and incident management).
Headed the greenfield oncology injectable and oral solid dose facility at KIZAD, Abu Dhabi.

roles.title: Deputy General Manager – Overseas Projects (Oncology, Inhalers, Potent products, HVAC)
points: Worked on projects across Europe and India: cytotoxic and non-cytotoxic injectables at Nerviano, Italy; inhalers (MDI and DPI) in Ireland; an HVAC project for a DPI facility in Istanbul, Turkey (on site); and HVAC for a high-containment lab in Goa.
Worked with international consultants such as Jacobs (Europe) and IPS (USA and India), and equipment suppliers from the UK and Germany.
Prepared concept documents, user requirements, layouts, scopes of work, business cases, costing and project schedules, and reviewed capex proposals across sites in Europe and Asia.

roles.title: Assistant General Manager – Corporate Projects (Oncology & Inhalers)
points: Handled key formulation projects in oncology, inhalers, ophthalmics and nasal sprays (about $20 million in capital cost).
Prepared concepts, layouts (area classification, pressure differentials, equipment and AHU zoning), engineering costing and business cases for capex approval.

roles.title: Senior Manager
points: Led the engineering team at a USFDA- and MHRA-approved export unit, reporting to the Vice-President (Operations).
Led the team to MHRA (UK) approval of the Unit-3 formulation block.
Managed a team of 25 across four formulation blocks and their utilities, including a block expansion project.
